events.title: Epicon joins Telstra Purple
events.text: Telstra acquired the Australian ITSM/ITOM provider. Its 100+ technical specialists covered the business, not a separately counted ServiceNow bench.
events.implication: Local expertise entered a broader services platform; the deal does not prove current cohort retention.

events.title: Enable becomes part of Fujitsu
events.text: Fujitsu’s partner profile records the August acquisition, following the July announcement.
events.implication: The APJ specialist lineage remains relevant to local delivery even after the parent brand changes.

events.title: CloudGo joins RGP’s Veracity business
events.text: RGP announced the acquisition of the Singapore, Australia and India specialist. Nearly 80 employees was an APAC-wide figure.
events.implication: A regional delivery platform was the asset, not an 80-person Australian team.

events.title: Cognizant completes Thirdera acquisition
events.text: The transaction added more than 940 employees globally.
events.implication: Global credentials increased; ANZ capacity still needs local evidence.

events.title: AC3 brings JDS into its services business
events.text: The two companies combined broader technology teams, including ServiceNow capability.
events.implication: The managed-services relationship and the specialist team can reinforce each other; integration quality remains the key question.

events.title: Coforge agrees to acquire TMLabs
events.text: The disclosure specifies 100% ownership and A$20m upfront plus contingent consideration. TMLabs now identifies itself as Coforge.
events.implication: The Australian architecture-led practice gives the buyer a specific local capability origin.

events.title: Growth capital backs national expansion
events.text: xAmplify confirms Macquarie Capital Principal Finance investment alongside its expansion plans.
events.implication: Capital supports a build-and-buy strategy. It does not establish a full sale or ServiceNow headcount growth.

events.title: CTO Group broadens xAmplify’s advisory capability
events.text: The company update confirms the acquisition across cloud, enterprise platforms and transformation.
events.implication: This expands the surrounding services proposition; it is not proof of a larger ServiceNow-certified cohort.

events.title: TCloud’s team moves under xAmplify’s public identity
events.text: TCloud directs its audience to xAmplify and describes its capability as part of the wider business.
events.implication: The lineage is supported. The brief’s 2025 deal date is not carried forward because earlier public material already shows the relationship.

events.implication: Recognition is visible. The award category and region stay explicit; it does not create an ANZ growth label.

events.implication: Recognition is visible. The award category and region stay explicit; it does not create an ANZ growth label.

events.title: Datacom receives APAC Reseller Rising Star
events.implication: Recognition is visible. The award category and region stay explicit; it does not create an ANZ growth label.

events.title: Nexon develops a talent pipeline
events.text: ServiceNow’s story describes graduate recruitment and transferable-skills development.
events.implication: A useful mechanism for building delivery capacity; the undated story is not treated as recent hiring velocity.

fact.text: Glen Watson’s Novabridge biography describes architecture and governance work on the Defence ServiceNow Protected Platform. This is practitioner-reported evidence; the prime-contract role and delivery dates are not specified.
AC3’s partner profile carries a Queensland Health custom-app case study. AC3 also publicly identifies its role delivering the Surgery Connect SCAN initiative alongside ServiceNow.
